ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious DNS Query for IP Lookup Service APIs
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects DNS queries for IP lookup services such as "api.ipify.org" originating from a non browser process. Note: Unmapped fields: QueryName

RGX(".*api\\\.ipify\\\.org.*") OR QueryName = RGX(".*bot\\\.whatismyipaddress\\\.com.*") OR QueryName = RGX(".*canireachthe\\\.net.*") OR QueryName = RGX(".*checkip\\\.amazonaws\\\.com.*") OR
